# Legal What?

> LegalWhat provides affordable legal guidance and answers to legal questions across 40+ areas of law. Ask by voice or text, analyze documents and media, research jurisdiction-specific issues, and create legal documents. The experience is powered by Lexara. Try LegalWhat free for 3 days, then $19.99/month.

Legal What? provides legal information and AI-assisted tools. It does not constitute legal advice.

## Core pages
- [Homepage](https://legalwhat.com/): Overview of LegalWhat and its affordable legal guidance, research, file analysis, and document tools.
- [Affordable legal guidance](https://legalwhat.com/affordable-legal-guidance/): Flagship resource for affordable legal guidance across 40 legal areas.
- [Affordable answers to legal questions](https://legalwhat.com/guides/affordable-answers-to-legal-questions/): Practical guide to asking legal questions online and understanding when professional representation may still be needed.
- [Capabilities](https://legalwhat.com/capabilities/): Hub for LegalWhat’s live conversation, affordability, document generation, background research, legal research, and file-analysis capabilities.
- [Live two-way legal conversation](https://legalwhat.com/live-legal-conversation/): Voice and text conversation with follow-up questions and jurisdiction awareness.
- [Legal document generator](https://legalwhat.com/legal-document-generator/): Conversational legal document preparation with jurisdiction-aware drafting and supported PDF/DOCX output.
- [Background and public-record search](https://legalwhat.com/background-search/): Public-source court, incarceration, licensing, business, and employment research.
- [Legal research assistant](https://legalwhat.com/legal-research-assistant/): Case-law, statute, rule, jurisdiction, and legal-issue research.
- [Legal file analysis](https://legalwhat.com/file-analysis/): Court-document, contract, notice, evidence, and revision analysis.
- [Legal consultation](https://legalwhat.com/legal-consultation): AI-assisted legal consultation.
- [Practice areas](https://legalwhat.com/areas/): Legal information and research coverage across 40 practice areas.
- [Services](https://legalwhat.com/services/): Legal What? service overview.
- [FAQ](https://legalwhat.com/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://legalwhat.com/contact): Support and contact information.
- [Privacy](https://legalwhat.com/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://legalwhat.com/terms): Terms of use.

## Services
- [AI legal consultation](https://legalwhat.com/services/ai-legal-consultation/): Lexara provides animated, natural two-way voice and text legal interaction across 40+ areas of law, media analysis and revision, and jurisdiction-aware legal document workflows.

## Search-intent resources
- [Legal guidance and research guides](https://legalwhat.com/guides/): Affordable legal guidance, legal answers, conversational assistance, legal research, case analysis, evidence/media analysis, public records, criminal procedure, appeals, post-conviction research, drafting, and document review.
- [Affordable legal document help](https://legalwhat.com/documents/): Public discovery pages for motions, complaints, contracts, demand letters, affidavits, appellate briefs, habeas petitions, FOIA requests, sentencing memoranda, and legal research memoranda.

LegalWhat's public discovery architecture describes capabilities in natural language while private user conversations, accounts, and protected workspaces remain outside search indexing.
